quote: I went to Dr. Culotta to help with my snoring after my wife sent me to the guest room for always waking her up. I’m only 39 so I hate the idea of using a CPAP so I waited years avoiding the issue. Dr. Culotta easily and expertly made me a device I wear inside my mouth (like a nightguard) that I wear at night. The snoring has completely gone and I’m back in my bed! No CPAP and not waking my wife, it’s a double win! The bonus… I finally feel rested when I wake up in the mornings.
name: Craig

quote: Dr. Culotta makes a point to gently explain what she's doing and why, which makes all the difference in the world. ALSO she has light, steady hands!!! I first had my tongue and lip ties released, and the entire encounter was as stress free as it could have been. Her experience working with little kids is apparent, because I felt like a real star after my follow up.
name: Rick

quote: Our child has a tongue tie that every other provider missed. Bottle, breastfeeding and solids were all a challenge. At 2 year we found Dr. Culotta. She helped us create a game plan to get speech therapy first, and then after a few months, J was ready for his tongue tie release. I was nervous before, though the process was easy. J started eating solids the very next day and swallowing without choking! Thanks to Dr. Culotta and her assistant Sheila.
name: Kellie
